folds.heading: ## Full schedule and execution reconciliation, 2026-11-04 (B185)
folds.body:
The complete schedule, ranks, stagesA–D, T1–T5, quoted go phrases and all SA/PI/R/WR execution sections were read. This document’s opening “nothing submitted” is historical after its own later approved/submitted runs, and its Nov1 timing window has passed. Later READlNG_STATUS records qualify the old waiting/gate/census state at their exact scope. Preserve the quoted approvals as provenance; they are not new permission to read keys, submit/relaunch paid requests, change price/model limits or restart old PIDs. No current credit, expiry, allowance, API/model capability or run status was checked.

Keep merge metrics honest. Registry ID resolution near1 was explained as near1 by construction, not source correctness. Seven stated-date roots and many unanchored scenes do not establish a complete global chronology. Empty affordance cells and indexed rows are discovery coverage, not missing mechanics. The opening88ambiguous-name count versus39automatic/56other figures does not form a verified disjoint partition; do not convert it into a new exact identity census without its actual retained inputs. Proposed overlay review remains distinct from a high resolve rate, with uncertain person/place/family merges preserved.

Budget estimates, per-label worst-case bounds, run measured ceilings and collected spend are different quantities. Old theoretical bounds assume their stated request/input/output/price configuration; later128K changes do not retroactively validate earlier cost comparisons. The $106potential total was explicitly above the credit, with staged measured-spend sizing, not authorization to spend that total. Keep failed StageA and subsequent first-gate outcomes, truncations/parse failures, glossary contamination and compared denominators intact. A repaired lint row does not establish factual truth; high effort yielding more rows does not prove better substance. WR5’s supported/partial/unsupported/trivial sample remains bounded, not a general model ranking or speed claim.

WR3/WR4 matter operationally: collecting already-submitted work differs from resubmission; a resume that skipped an already-collected failing gate was an actual reported driver error, later repaired, not evidence the earlier stage passed. The source reports’ output/thinking explanation is attributed to their retained observations, not a new wire measurement here. Current actual source-read/quality/scene/readiness needs remain with their owners. No gate was bypassed, data regraded, private source opened, inference launched or reading priority changed during this reconciliation.
